thread:
maria: Heads up — PR #4585 updates the SOC2 audit-log examples to SDK v2 but I noticed two problems: the Go snippet still uses v1 imports, and a couple of links redirect to the old /sdk/v1 paths. Can someone take a look? cc @alex @priya

alex: on it. which files are affected?

maria: docs/audit/logs.md and docs/sdk/go/audit_examples.md — also docs/examples/embed-audit.md has a curl example hitting /api/v1/audit which should be /api/v2.

priya: thanks for the flag. security-wise we need to keep the redaction example identical (no behavioral change) — just mechanical API/SDK updates. please ensure the note about pseudonymization stays. :eyes:

maria: yes — no wording changes, just code/links. here's the JS snippet in the PR that looks correct:

```js
// SDK v2 example (JS)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk/v2';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await client.audit.log({ event: 'user_login', actor: 'alice@example.com' });
```

alex: got it. i'll prepare a small patch for the Go snippet and update the redirects. locking down now.

alex: provisional Go fix (will push as PR commit):

```go
// SDK v2 (Go)
import (
  "context"
  "github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2"
)
func sendAudit(ctx context.Context, c *redwood.Client) error {
  _, err := c.Audit.Log(ctx, redwood.AuditEvent{Action: "user_login", Actor: "alice@example.com"})
  return err
}
```

maria: perfect — can you also update the internal redirect rule from /sdk/v1/audit -> /sdk/v2/audit so old links in external docs live redirects don't 404?

alex: yup, will add a redirect in the docs config.

priya: quick check for retention language: dan, legal ok with leaving the retention wording verbatim? we didn't change TTL or redaction semantics.

dan: confirmed — as long as there are no semantics changes and only examples/links are updated, legal is happy. please add a one-line changelog in the PR description noting "no policy changes — examples updated for SDK v2".

maria: thumbs up. alex, can you add the changelog note and squash the Go fix into the PR?

alex: will do, pushing commit in ~10m. :shipit:

docs-bot: Preview deployed — https://deploy.preview.redwood/doc/5210001111 PR #4585 (view) :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all. i'll do a quick QA pass on the preview after the commit and close the thread. :thumbsup:
